author: jvranek
content: heads up, the spec says empty `auth_data` is invalid. You should set it explicitly to something non-empty or omit it from the config and the VC will by default derive `auth_data` from the `url` hostname. Setting `auth_data = ""` causes Lodestar / Prysm to error at startup and I believe Lighthouse uses it as-is and will error when its your turn to ask for a bid 😅
